title: Little Girl Holding Baby Brother on Chair, 1968 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot from August 1968 capturing a young girl standing beside a dark metal folding chair, gently holding a baby boy sitting on the worn vinyl seat. The girl wears a white sleeveless shift dress with dark shoes and white socks, while the barefoot baby wears a light plaid button-up shirt and shorts. They pose outdoors against a paneled wooden wall. The left border bears the photo processing stamp 'AUG 1968'.
